label: The Port Desert
note: IP-neutral. The world around the port, for flying: where the desert ends and the planet curves away, the landmarks set in it, and the height where the atmosphere ends. The desert's shape is the town's DesertTerrain (src/systems/look/desert_terrain.gd) and its mesas and hoodoos are content/look/desert_landforms.json; this file does not repeat them. terrain.extent = the desert's half-size (its own extent wins when the desert is built); beyond it the ground is skirt_height falling away on a sphere of planet_radius from curve_from. Altitude is measured above that curved surface, so space_altitude is the same everywhere. Colours: content/look/world.json.
